fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Jump infantry in League service exploit vertical mobility to compensate for the FWLM's sometimes fragmented command structure, seizing terrain that wheeled or tracked forces cannot reach. Their ability to operate across broken ground and urban environments makes them valuable in the border provinces where coalition territory changes hands frequently. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
